title: Spotlight: Bombay High Court Justice Madhav Jamdar
description: Spotlight is a series where we shine the, well, spotlight on members of the legal fraternity who made the news over the past week.Bombay High Court judge Justice Madhav Jamdar found himself under the spotlight this past week after his oral remarks during a politically charged hearing went viral online.
